title: Tool Settings
subtitle: Tool execution configuration and available tool list

config.title: Execution Behavior
config.description: Control confirmation and timeout policies for tool calls.

config.autoExecuteDesc: Skip user confirmation before tool execution.
config.subagentMaxConcurrencyDesc: Maximum number of tasks that can run at the same time.
config.swarmMaxConcurrencyDesc: How many Swarm Workers and Reviewers may run in parallel. This is independent of the ordinary subagent limit.
config.confirmTimeoutDesc: Maximum seconds to wait for user confirmation of tool calls.
config.executionTimeoutDesc: Maximum time for a single tool operation. Set 0 for no limit.
config.userQuestionTimeoutDesc: Maximum seconds to wait for the user to start answering. Set 0 for no limit; default is 180 seconds.

subagentBatchPolicy.label: Task concurrency
subagentBatchPolicy.desc: Choose how multiple tasks run when they start together.
subagentBatchPolicy.safeOnlyDesc: Run tasks together only when they do not modify content
subagentBatchPolicy.forceParallelDesc: Run multiple tasks together whenever possible
